description: Combined price, and combined probability if you supply yours, for two to twenty legs. Arithmetic on your own numbers only: nothing is stored and no outside data is read. Research intelligence (probabilities, factors, context), not winning picks. Price: Free, no signup. Research and information, not betting advice. No outcomes are guaranteed. Adults 21+ only, where legal. Problem gambling help: 1-800-MY-RESET.

harness.description: Optional display hint. It changes the output format only, never access, price or limits.

american.description: American odds as a signed integer with a magnitude of at least 100, for example -110 or 150.

decimal.description: Decimal odds greater than 1, for example 1.91.

price.description: Your own price from your own source: give exactly one of american or decimal odds.

win_probability.description: Optional: your own probability for this leg.

stake.description: Optional stake; when given the response includes the payout.

visual.description: Optional. How to present the result: auto (default, chosen by client), image (picture and link), text (terminal chart), none (data only).

name: calc_parlay

billing.description: Always free for the calculators: status free, price_micros 0.

result.description: The arithmetic on the numbers you sent. Every price and probability in it is your own input or derived from it.

error.description: Failure only: code, message, request_id, billable (always false).
